name: luna-pool-orchestrator
description: The first Heliolune adapter: cost-first engineering orchestration with bounded Luna workers and a shared reporting leader.

interface.shortDescription: Supervise capable models; delegate bounded work cheaply.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune runs four function-affine Luna/max workers and one adaptive Luna/high operations leader behind a blocking MCP call. Sol retains planning, architecture, risk, review, and final acceptance while large or risky worker bundles are compressed and small tasks avoid leader overhead.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $luna-pool-orchestrator to delegate this bounded engineering task to a hidden Luna/max lane.
